WILD THEORY: Valve is deliberately ruining Dota 2 to channel players into Deadlock.
They make your experience absolutely miserable, make it feel pointless to play, and outright disrupt and revoke your ability to play AT ALL if you are still passionate enough about DotA for some reason.
It has been going for a while now, seemingly taking a turn for the worse every time.
So maybe it is not incompetence, but a malicious intent to siphon active players to their new favorite child, the moba-adjacent hero shooter?
Prove me wrong.

Because there are so many cancer heroes in this meta.

Add on top people griefing with heroes like sniper pos 5 as in my last game on divine 1 btw even and this is one of the most frustrating patches in a long time..
Oh and another thing is that some are even confused about which hero is played in which role at this point.. templar assassin or shadow fiend mid are also not really a thing anymore, they are better carries now, but SF already got nerfed and is crap now
Dota became quite random

and its already going like this since many months at this point
